titel: Episode 0:  Fast. Feast. Repeat. Intermittent Fasting for Life

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Welcome to the launch of Fast Feast Repeat, an intermittent fasting podcast by Jen…
kurzfassung: Hosts Jen Stevens and Sherri Bullock launch their new podcast dedicated to intermittent fasting, health, and wellness. In this introductory episode, they share their personal weight loss and fasting journeys, including how they overcame metabolic struggles. They also outline the show's format, which will feature listener celebrations, expert tips, research discussions, and community submissions.
stichpunkte: Jen Stevens and Sherri Bullock introduce their new podcast focusing on intermittent fasting and health.
Jen shares her story of losing 80 pounds in 2014 and maintaining it through intermittent fasting.
Sherri discusses her background as a sturdy athlete and how moving to Alabama led to weight gain after years of restrictive dieting.
Sherri initially resisted Jen's clean fasting rules before realizing the science behind cephalic phase insulin response.
The hosts explain that upcoming episodes will feature listener success stories, weekly tweaks, and health research.
A detailed listener success story highlights how intermittent fasting reversed severe insulin resistance in one year.
The hosts encourage listeners to submit their questions, success stories, and book recommendations via their website.

clips.hook: Losing 80 pounds and keeping it off
clips.text: After struggling with weight fluctuations for decades and reaching 210 pounds, Jen successfully lost 80 pounds and maintained the loss for years.
Upon discovering the strict fasting rules in the online support group, Sherri initially thought the concept was nonsense and refused to give up her favorite drinks.

clips.hook: Curing insulin resistance in one year
clips.text: By incorporating longer fasts, a listener managed to lower her A1C, normalize her fasting blood glucose, and drop her fasting insulin to 2.5.
Elevated fasting insulin often goes unnoticed for a decade before a person is formally diagnosed with diabetes, making glucose tests alone insufficient.

clips.hook: Growth happens outside the comfort zone
clips.text: Making meaningful life changes requires pushing past fears and stepping away from familiar habits.

beschreibung:
Welcome to a special BONUS episode of Gin's and Sheri's new podcast! Today, you can listen to a sneak peek of Fast. Feast. Repeat. Intermittent Fasting for Life, with Gin Stephens and Sheri Bullock.

This is episode 0, and episode 1 will come out on 7/5/23. If you like what you hear in this bonus episode, make sure to go to your favorite podcast app and subscribe to the new podcast today. Once you subscribe, you'll get a new episode of the Fast Feast Repeat podcast every Wednesday. And, no worries! The Intermittent Fasting Stories podcast will still be released following the same schedule you're used to.

To make a submission for the podcast, go to fastfeastrepeat.com/submit. We are a community-driven podcast, and we look forward to sharing your questions, success stories, non-scale victories, IF tweaks, motivational quotes (and more!) on each episode of the podcast.

Go to fastfeastrepeat.com to see Gin’s and Sheri’s favorite things, and to shop with us. Every purchase you make through links on our website help to support this podcast so we can keep bringing you episodes each week.

Are you ready to take your intermittent fasting lifestyle to the next level? There’s nothing better than community to help with that. In the Delay, Don’t Deny community we all embrace the clean fast, and there’s just the right support for you as you live your intermittent fasting lifestyle.

Connect with both Gin and Sheri in the community, as well as thousands of other intermittent fasters who are there to support you along your journey. If you’re new to intermittent fasting or recommitting to the IF lifestyle, join the 28-Day FAST Start group. After your fast start, join us for support in The 1st Year group. Need tips for long term maintenance? We have a place for that! There are many more useful spaces beyond these, and you can interact in as many as you like.

Visit ginstephens.com/community to join us. An annual membership costs just over a dollar a week when you do the math. If you aren’t ready to fully commit for a year, join for a month and you can cancel at any time. If you know you’ll want to stay forever, we also have a lifetime membership option available.

IF is free. You don’t need to join our community to fast. But if you’re looking for support from a community of like-minded IFers, we are here for you at ginstephens.com/community.
